verdict_reason: The only change, dropping the dead OIDC mock, is correct; six titles in the file say 'expected' instead of what they assert.

todos.issue: Titles claim 'expected' pages instead of stating what the assertions prove: line 36 'Should provide expected Not Found page' (asserts the 'Page not found' title and 404), lines 118, 129, 140, 154 'Should provide expected "Not Found"/"Forbidden"/"Unauthorized"/"Bad Request" page' (assert the error view, its title, heading and status code, and no stack log), line 168 'Should provide expected default page' (asserts 'Something went wrong' with the given status).
todos.fix: Must: each title names the page title or status and the logging it asserts. One way: 'Should render the Page not found page with a 404', 'Should render the Forbidden error view with a 403 and log no stack', 'Should render Something went wrong for an unmapped status and keep that status'.
